paper.title: Algorithm 352: Characteristic values and associated solutions of Mathieu's differential equation
paper.note: The article is not read. The archive is netlib TOMS/CALGO 352.gz (2006 Fortran conversion by John Burkardt), fetched inside the sandbox, sha256 00efa50b...fee.

stack: Fortran (netlib 352.gz driver.f and src.f, unpacked verbatim); built with GNU Fortran 16.2.0 (conda-forge) in the sandbox

claim.text: a_5(5), the even Mathieu characteristic value at R = 5, Q = 5, as printed in the Computed column of TEST05 in the shipped reference output res. Registered tolerance: abs 1e-5.

attempt: Ran the authors' driver.f and src.f unmodified, compiled with gfortran -O2 in a build directory outside the tree (the Makefile's $(F77) is unset and absent, so the compiler name is given on the command line). Two passes, each in a fresh run directory: the TEST05 row R=5, Q=5 prints 25.549972 (Computed) in both passes, against the registered 25.549972 with tol 1e-5. Build-only: no source edit (verify_sources record).
